long_biography.plain_text:
At Haley Automotive Group, James Douglas 'Doug' Pridgen Jr. developed a regional dealership company by combining established franchises. He worked for decades with fellow executive David Trebour, while a consolidation brought Ron Ferguson's long-established Volvo business into Haley and retained its experienced management.

Pridgen also led purchases that added Chevrolet, GMC, Buick and Chrysler-group dealerships to the company. His role encompassed ownership and chief-executive responsibility as the private group broadened its franchise mix. His daughter Kinsey later moved through Haley's operating departments before becoming president, establishing a second generation of family leadership.
